detail: Art. 1.5 of Decret 96/2026 empowers each public university's consell social (and the UOC's Patronat) to set the per-credit price at ANY study level for non-resident foreign students who are not nationals of EU member states or of states where the EU regime applies, capped at 100% of the cost of the service: 'Els consells socials de les universitats publiques i el Patronat de la Fundacio per a la Universitat Oberta de Catalunya poden establir el preu dels credits en qualsevol nivell d'estudis per als i les estudiants estrangers no residents que no siguin nacionals d'estats membres de la Unio Europea ni dels estats en els quals sigui aplicable el regim comunitari, sense que el preu corresponent pugui excedir el 100% del seu cost'. CRITICAL: the same article states that a Spanish long-stay STUDENT authorisation does NOT make you a resident - 'l'autoritzacio d'estada de llarga durada per estudis, mobilitat d'estudiants, serveis de voluntariat o activitats formatives concedida als i les estudiants estrangers no equival a la condicio de residents' - so a Tunisian student-visa holder is legally 'non-resident' and exposed to the surcharge. The decree itself does NOT fix the non-EU amount; each university does, so the actual figure must be read off the university's own tariff (wave-1 evidence: UPC ~EUR 5,400 vs ~EUR 2,324; UB 82 EUR/ECTS vs 27 EUR/ECTS).

detail: Madrid has NOT issued a new annual decree; DECRETO 43/2022, de 29 de junio, del Consejo de Gobierno remains the operative precios publicos decree and its tariffs are still being applied for 2026/2027 (URJC publishes them under that decree for curso 2026/2027). Mechanism: non-EU non-resident students are charged the SAME rate as a 3rd-or-later enrolment, i.e. the highest ordinary band. URJC's official 2026/2027 tariff table reads verbatim: '3a Matricula y sucesivas y estudiantes extracomunitarios, no residentes: 84,07 EUR' against '1a matricula: 45,02 EUR' for the 'restantes ensenanzas de master' band. The Comunidad de Madrid's own precios-publicos page states the rule verbatim: 'En el caso de los restantes estudios de master, lo previsto para la tercera y sucesivas matriculas en el Articulo 4 del decreto de precios publicos (84,07 EUR por credito), o lo previsto para extracomunitarios en el Anexo IV del mismo decreto' - Anexo IV holds singularised prices for specific masters (masteres con precio singularizado), which can be higher. The regional page also states that a study stay authorisation does not confer residence: 'La autorizacion de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros no equivaldra a la condicion de residentes'. This pins the wave-3 university figures (UAH 2,736 -> 5,079; UC3M 130 -> 195/ECTS; UCM ~3,200 -> ~5,100; URJC 45.02 -> 84.07) to Decreto 43/2022 rates as applied in 2025-26 and 2026-27. Effective multiplier on the ordinary master band: x1.867.

detail: Andalusia uses the same 'authorisation up to 100% of cost' model as Catalonia and Asturias - the decree does NOT fix a non-EU price. Art. 3.1 verbatim: 'El estudiantado que no sea nacional de un Estado miembro del Espacio Economico Europeo o de Suiza y sea residente en Espana conforme a la Ley Organica 4/2000 ... abonara los precios previstos en este decreto.' Art. 3.2 verbatim: 'El estudiantado extranjero mencionado en el apartado 1 que no sea residente en Espana abonara los precios por los servicios academicos y administrativos previstos en este decreto. No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podran establecer una variacion en el precio de los creditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio academico; todo ello, sin perjuicio de lo previsto en los acuerdos y los convenios o tratados internacionales sobre la materia.' NOTE the default is favourable: the baseline rule is that the non-resident non-EU student pays the SAME decree prices, and a surcharge only exists if the individual university has resolved to apply one - the opposite default to Madrid/Valencia. Universidad de Sevilla's published 2025-26/2026-27 tariff shows NO differentiated extracomunitario row, i.e. US charges 13.68 EUR/credit to everyone. Andalusia is therefore the CHEAPEST public option identified in this sweep: a 60-ECTS non-habilitante master in the Ingenierias y Arquitectura group costs 13.68 x 60 = 820.80 EUR. The Decreto 142/2025 amendment (BOJA 172, 2.9.2025) does NOT touch art. 3. Andalusia additionally offers a 99% bonificacion on credits passed at first enrolment (art. 12), open on academic not nationality grounds.

detail: CONFIRMED BY FULL-TEXT SEARCH OF THE ORDEN, not by absence on a summary page. The BOPV text of the UPV/EHU pricing Orden (ORDEN de 19 de junio de 2025, BOPV n. 120, 26.6.2025, disposicion 2857) was downloaded and grepped for 'extracomunitario', 'extranjero', 'no residente' and 'Union Europea'. The ONLY hits for 'extranjero' are unrelated administrative services (homologation of foreign degrees, equivalence declarations, foreign private-centre credit recognition, Anexo II service items 1.2-1.5). There is NO article, no annex row and no clause anywhere in the Orden that differentiates price by nationality or residence, and no authorisation for the university to do so. Art. 2.1 sets the price purely as credit price x grado de experimentalidad x enrolment number. The Basque Country is therefore the ONLY community verified in this sweep with a genuinely nationality-blind public tariff (Andalusia is close but its art. 3.2 still permits a university to vary). This makes UPV/EHU the lowest-risk public-fee jurisdiction for this candidate: an Engineering-branch (experimentalidad 3) 60-ECTS master costs 32.45 x 60 = 1,947 EUR at first enrolment with NO surcharge. For 2026-2027 the successor instrument is the Orden de 1 de junio de 2026 (BOPV 17.6.2026); the Basque Government announced a price freeze, but that 2026 text was NOT itself opened here, so the figures quoted are the VERIFIED 2025-26 ones - treat the 2026-27 amounts as expected-unchanged, not confirmed. UPV/EHU's own master fees page likewise shows no extracomunitario row.

detail: CONFIRMED BY FULL-TEXT SEARCH OF THE DECREE. The BOCyL text of DECRETO 8/2024 was downloaded and grepped for 'extracomunitario', 'extranjero', 'no residente', 'Union Europea': the only 'extranjero' hits are art. 3.3 (interuniversity masters with foreign universities) and unrelated administrative-service items (language tests for foreign students, homologation of foreign degrees, Anexo item 1.7/1.11/1.14). There is NO nationality- or residence-based price band and NO clause authorising universities to create one. Article 3 verbatim: '1. En el caso de ensenanzas universitarias oficiales conducentes a la obtencion de los titulos de Master Universitario, el precio a satisfacer sera el resultado de sumar el precio de los creditos asignados a cada materia y actividad formativa, de acuerdo con lo establecido en el Anexo II. 2. En el caso de que la universidad exigiese complementos formativos entre los requisitos de admision al master, el precio a satisfacer sera el resultado de sumar el precio de los creditos asignados, dentro del tipo de master universitario del que se trate ... 3. Las universidades publicas podran fijar precios distintos a los previstos en este decreto para los masteres interuniversitarios con universidades espanolas o extranjeras, de acuerdo con lo establecido por la Conferencia General de Politica Universitaria y sin que, en ningun caso, se supere los limites vigentes en el curso 2019-2020.' The figure the brief flagged as sitting in a linked PDF is now pinned: Universidad de Salamanca's official master tariff sheet states 26,20 EUR/credit first enrolment for masteres NO habilitantes (76,21 EUR for 2nd/3rd/4th), and 16,34 EUR for habilitantes, expressly citing 'Decreto 8/2024, de 30 de mayo (BOCyL de 3 de junio de 2024) ... para el curso academico 2024-2025 (prorrogado al curso 2025-26)'. USAL's table has NO extracomunitario row. So a 60-ECTS non-habilitante master in CyL costs 26.20 x 60 = 1,572 EUR for this candidate, same as for a Spaniard. Note art. 3.2: if the university imposes complementos formativos at admission they are charged at the same master credit price - relevant to the 300-ECTS question. NOT VERIFIED: that the prorroga extends specifically to 2026-27; the primary sources opened confirm the extension only through 2025-26.

detail: RESOLVES the wave-3 open item on Galicia's non-habilitante band AND on 'set by separate rectoral resolution, amount unpublished'. The 2026/27 decree is DECRETO 72/2026, do 29 de xuno (DOG num. 127, 9.7.2026). Art. 2.5 verbatim (Spanish version): 'La universidad establecera, mediante una resolucion rectoral debidamente motivada, los precios a abonar por la matricula en estudios de grado y master por el alumnado extranjero mayor de dieciocho anos que no tenga la condicion de residente de larga duracion o permanente en Espana, con exclusion de aquellas personas que sean nacionales de Estados miembros de la Union Europea o aquellas a quienes sea de aplicacion el regimen comunitario. En todo caso, estos precios tendran como limite maximo los vigentes para esta tipologia de estudiantado en el curso 2025/26 en la misma universidad.' TWO POINTS THAT MATTER. (a) The wording is TIGHTER than Catalonia/Asturias/Andalusia: it requires 'residente de larga duracion o permanente', so a Tunisian on a student stay authorisation is unambiguously caught - and it obliges the university to issue a REASONED rectoral resolution, so the figure is a published administrative act obtainable from each university, not a hidden internal tariff. (b) Unlike Catalonia (100%-of-cost ceiling) Galicia imposes a FREEZE CAP: the non-EU price cannot exceed what that same university charged non-EU students in 2025/26. Galicia is thus the only community found with an explicit anti-escalation cap on the non-EU price. USC confirms on its own prices page that its non-EU prices for grado, master and doctorate are fixed by rectoral resolution, but does NOT publish the amount there - it must be requested per university (USC, UDC, UVigo). The resident band is now fully pinned (see fields below): a 60-ECTS 'other official master' in group A costs 13.93 x 60 = 835.80 EUR for a resident.

RESTANTES MASTERES OFICIALES (tarifa 1a ap. 3): grupo A 13.93 (1a) and 38.54 (2a y sucesivas); grupo B 9.85 (1a) and 26.68 (2a y sucesivas). So the 9.85-38.54 band the brief flagged is the full non-habilitante range across both groups and both enrolment tiers.

detail: MAJOR FINDING. Aragon fixes the non-EU price IN THE DECREE ITSELF (unlike Catalonia/Andalusia/Asturias/CLM/Galicia) and does so at TRIPLE for one category. DECRETO 120/2026, de 24 de junio, del Gobierno de Aragon (BOA num. 122, 29.6.2026), Articulo 4 'Precios para el estudiantado extranjero', verbatim: '1. Para estudiantes procedentes del extranjero no residentes en Espana, que no sean nacionales de estados miembros de la Union Europea, se establecen los siguientes precios: a) Ensenanzas de Grado y de Master Universitario que habiliten para actividades profesionales reguladas en Espana (incluidos los Masteres Universitarios no habilitantes con precio diferenciado): el precio de los creditos sera EL TRIPLE de los precios fijados en los anexos de este Decreto para la ensenanza de que se trate, sin perjuicio de lo que prevean los convenios o tratados internacionales en esta materia y del principio de reciprocidad. ... b) Ensenanzas de Master Universitario no habilitantes para actividades profesionales reguladas en Espana: el precio de los creditos sera EL DOBLE de los precios fijados en los anexos de este Decreto para la ensenanza de que se trate ...' Art. 4.2 verbatim: 'El precio de los creditos se calculara en funcion de la condicion de nacionalidad o de residencia en Espana acreditada por el estudiantado extranjero al comienzo del curso academico 2026/2027.' ESCAPE HATCH - and it is real and worth chasing: both subparagraphs contain a convenio override. For habilitantes: 'el estudiantado extranjero no residente en Espana que vaya a realizar los estudios ... en el marco de acuerdos o convenios de colaboracion firmados por la Universidad de Zaragoza conducentes a favorecer su grado de internacionalizacion, podra pagar EL DOBLE de los precios en lugar del triple, si asi lo contempla el correspondiente acuerdo o convenio.' For NON-habilitantes (the relevant category for AI/data-science/audio masters): '... podra pagar EL MISMO PRECIO que el estudiantado nacional de estados miembros de la Union Europea, si asi lo contempla el correspondiente acuerdo o convenio de colaboracion.' i.e. an applicable UNIZAR international collaboration agreement ELIMINATES the surcharge entirely on a non-habilitante master. Worth checking whether any Tunisia/Maghreb UNIZAR convenio applies. Worked example on the Anexo III standard rate: non-habilitante master 30.40 EUR/credit x 2 = 60.80 EUR/credit for this candidate; 60 ECTS = 3,648 EUR instead of 1,824 EUR. Note also the 0% price increase across all bands for 2026/2027 (Consejo Social proposal of 27.5.2026 adopted in the decree).
price_per_ects_resident_eur: 30.40 (Anexo III, masteres universitarios NO habilitantes y Erasmus Mundus, 1a matricula; 60.76 for 2a y sucesivas). Habilitantes and precio-diferenciado masters are in Anexo II; grado in Anexo I by grado de experimentalidad.

detail: RESOLVES the wave-3 blocker (Canary price page 404, ULPGC PDF 403). Route that worked: the Universidad de La Laguna Secretaria General normativa export at https://www.ull.es/portal/normativa/?ull_export_pdf=1430 serves the complete 28-page consolidated text of DECRETO 177/2022 and is NOT blocked. Full-text search of that document for 'extranjero', 'no residente', 'Union Europea', 'cien por cien' returns ONLY unrelated hits: art. 6.2 on credit recognition for studies done at Spanish private or foreign centres, and Tarifa Segunda/Tercera administrative items on homologation and equivalence of foreign degrees. There is NO article creating a non-EU or non-resident price band and NO authorisation for the universities to create one. This REFUTES the search-engine summaries that assert a Canary '100% of cost for non-resident foreign students' rule - that language belongs to the generic LOU/LOSU framework, not to this decree. CONTRADICTION LOGGED, resolved in favour of the primary text. Practical effect: ULL and ULPGC charge a Tunisian student the same as a Spaniard. A 60-ECTS non-habilitante master at experimentality grade 3 (engineering/computing typical) costs 12.80 x 60 = 768 EUR - the cheapest verified figure in this entire sweep, marginally below Andalusia. Duration: Disposicion final primera verbatim: 'Las previsiones normativas contempladas en el presente Decreto, asi como los importes concernientes a los precios publicos previstos en el mismo, continuaran resultando de aplicacion para los cursos academicos sucesivos en tanto este no sea objeto de modificacion o derogacion expresa. A tal efecto, los plazos establecidos para el curso academico 2022-2023 deberan aplicarse atendiendo a las fechas equivalentes del ano correspondiente.' So the 2022-23 tariff is the live 2026-27 tariff by automatic prorroga - no annual decree is issued in Canarias, which is why the 'annual decreto' search kept 404ing.

detail: Current instrument is ORDEN FORAL 63E/2026, de 8 de junio, del Consejero de Universidad, Innovacion y Transformacion Digital, por la que se fijan los precios publicos para el curso 2026/2027 ... en la Universidad Publica de Navarra - a true 2026/27 text, obtained in full. Articulo 4 'Precios para el estudiantado extranjero' verbatim: '1.- La Universidad Publica de Navarra, a traves del Consejo Social, PODRA incrementar el precio de los creditos en cualquier nivel de estudios para el estudiantado extranjero no residente, que no sea nacional de Estados miembros de la Union Europea, y a quienes sea de aplicacion el regimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad, hasta el 100% de los costes de la ensenanza de que se trate. 2.- En el marco de los convenios que la Universidad Publica de Navarra suscriba, y que respondan al ambito de acciones en materia de INTERNACIONALIZACION, COOPERACION AL DESARROLLO O DE SOLIDARIDAD CON LOS PUEBLOS O COLECTIVOS DESFAVORECIDOS, la Universidad podra otorgar EXENCION DE PRECIOS DE MATRICULA en Grado, Master Universitario o Doctorado en los terminos que esten previstos en el respectivo convenio.' Two things follow. (a) The surcharge is PERMISSIVE ('podra'), delegated to the Consejo Social, and UPNA's own published master fees page for the current course shows a single uniform tariff with NO extracomunitario row - i.e. the power exists on paper but is not being exercised, so the candidate would in practice pay the resident rate. That is a permission, not a guarantee: it can be switched on by a Consejo Social act without a new Orden Foral. (b) Art. 4.2 is the most explicit development-cooperation fee-waiver clause found in any Spanish regional pricing instrument, and it covers Master Universitario outright - a Tunisia-relevant UPNA convenio would zero the tuition. Worth pursuing directly with UPNA's Servicio de Relaciones Internacionales. Note parallel arts. 5 and 6 apply the same up-to-100% power to visiting and 'agregado' students, so enrolling as a visiting student is NOT a way round it.

detail: CONFIRMED BY FULL-TEXT SEARCH of the DOE text of DECRETO 145/2026, de 14 de julio (DOE num. 138, 20.7.2026, disp. 2026040176) - a genuine 2026/2027 decree. Grepped for 'extranjero', 'no residente', 'Union Europea', 'extracomunitario': the only hits are unrelated administrative-service items (200 EUR for evaluation of foreign studies, homologation prueba de conjunto, equivalence of foreign doctorates) and two masters whose SUBJECT is foreign-language teaching. There is NO nationality- or residence-based price band, and NO clause authorising the Universidad de Extremadura to create one. Art. on master pricing simply says: 'En el caso de estudios conducentes al titulo oficial de Master, el valor de los creditos a abonar se determina en el anexo III, en funcion del Grado de Experimentalidad previsto en el anexo II.' Extremadura is therefore the THIRD community (with Basque Country, Castilla y Leon and Canarias) verified as nationality-blind. Note its master rates are markedly higher than Andalusia/Canarias despite the low grado tariff - a 60-ECTS non-habilitante master at experimentality 2 (the band containing Master en Direccion TIC, Gestion de la Innovacion Tecnologica, Informatica Industrial y Robotica, Energias Renovables) costs 37.41 x 60 = 2,244.60 EUR. Extremadura also grants a 99% bonificacion on credits passed at first enrolment, awarded on academic not nationality grounds. detail: CONFIRMED from UIB's own official master programme pages, which print the rule on every master's price block. Verbatim in Catalan: 'Preu aplicable als nacionals dels Estats membres de la Unio Europea i residents a l'Estat espanyol. En la resta de casos s'aplica un increment del 30%.' This is the mildest EXPLICIT surcharge found anywhere in Spain - a flat +30%, versus Valencia x2, Aragon x2/x3, Madrid x1.87, and Catalonia's uncapped up-to-100%-of-cost. Note the eligibility wording is DISJUNCTIVE-FAVOURABLE in form but not in substance for this candidate: the base price applies to EU nationals AND to residents in Spain; a Tunisian on a student stay authorisation is neither an EU national nor (per the Catalan Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 reasoning, and the general Spanish rule that an estancia por estudios is not residencia) a resident, so the +30% applies. Worked example, verified on a live 2026-27 UIB master page: base 29.22 EUR/credit, 60 ECTS = 1,794.39 EUR for an EU/resident student; +30% = approx. 38.00 EUR/credit and approx. 2,332.71 EUR for this candidate. The governing instrument is an Acord del Consell de Govern (the 2025-26 one is the Acord del Consell de Govern de 27 de juny de 2025, published in BOIB), issued under Llei 2/1997, de 3 de juny, de taxes de la comunitat autonoma de les Illes Balears - Balears sets university prices by Consell de Govern agreement rather than by decret. The Govern approved the 2026-27 prices holding grado and master prices unchanged and only updating the socioeconomic thresholds for exemptions; the master price was previously cut by about 10 EUR/credit to bring masters into line with grados. GAP: the BOIB number and article of the 2026-27 Acord were not obtained - the +30% rule is sourced from UIB's own programme pages, not from the BOIB text itself.

detail: UPGRADED from NOT FOUND by retrieving the BOC text. The Orden UIC/10/2023, de 26 de mayo (BOC num. 110, 8.6.2023, CVE-2023-5295), which fixes UC public prices, was downloaded in full and grepped for 'extranjero', 'no residente', 'Union Europea', 'extracomunitario': the ONLY hit is an unrelated administrative fee (prueba de conjunto para homologacion de titulos extranjeros de educacion superior, 130.75 EUR). There is NO nationality- or residence-based price band and NO enabling clause letting the UC create one. The Orden's structure is purely by rama de conocimiento and matricula number: art. 3 (masteres habilitantes, Anexo 2), art. 4 (masteres NO habilitantes, Anexo 3), art. 5 (four named engineering masters). Cantabria therefore joins Pais Vasco, Castilla y Leon, Canarias and Extremadura as nationality-blind. IMPORTANT CAVEATS. (1) The verified text is 2023-24. The Universidad de Cantabria states verbatim for the current year: 'El importe de los precios publicos ... se establece para el curso academico 2026/2027 por la Orden de la Consejeria de Universidades, Igualdad, Cultura y Deporte del Gobierno de Cantabria' and 'Para el curso 2026/27 se prorroga la Orden de la Consejeria, por lo que se mantienen los mismos precios que para el curso 2025/26.' The intervening 2024-25 / 2025-26 Orden was not opened, so a clause introduced after 2023 would not have been seen. (2) Cantabria modified its precios publicos regime in June 2026 to make matricula FREE for Cantabrian students entering the UC - a residency-gated benefit that by construction excludes this candidate, and the modifying instrument was not read here. A human should open the current BOC Orden and the UC's 'Precios Master 2026-2027.pdf'. Art. 4 is also notable for a deliberate REDUCTION policy: 'Se procede a una disminucion del precio publico fijado para la primera matricula ... La Comunidad Autonoma de Cantabria reembolsara a la Universidad de Cantabria el coste que suponga la minoracion del precio de primera matricula' - the region compensates the university via the Contrato-Programa, so the low first-enrolment master price is a funded political choice, not a drafting accident.

The instrument chain is now pinned: the base decree is DECRETO 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell, por el que se regulan los precios publicos de los servicios academicos y complementarios universitarios - it is NOT reissued annually; it is AMENDED. Two amendments located on the Generalitat's own decret-preus-publics page: DECRETO 195/2025, de 12 de diciembre and DECRETO 122/2026, de 4 de agosto (the operative amendment for the 2026-2027 course). The Consell has publicly confirmed prices are frozen again for 2026-2027 and that the normativa was adapted to the 'internacionalizacion de las ensenanzas'. So a 2027-28 intake will be priced under Decreto 101/2024 as amended, unless a further amendment lands in mid-2027. EFFECT ON THIS CANDIDATE: the x2 multiplier is one of the two harshest explicit surcharges in Spain alongside Aragon (which reaches x3 for habilitantes). It applies across the Sistema Universitari Valencia, i.e. UPV, UV, UA, UJI, UMH. NOT VERIFIED HERE: the article number of the x2 clause inside Decreto 101/2024 and its exact verbatim Spanish/Valencian wording were not read from the DOGV text in this session - the Generalitat's decree page carries only links to the DOGV, not the text. The x2 figure itself is sound (primary-sourced from UMH in wave 3); the article citation is the gap.

detail: EXTENDS and pins the wave-3 Asturias finding to a specific 2026-2027 instrument: DECRETO 45/2026, de 22 de junio, por el que se fijan los precios publicos que regiran para los estudios conducentes a titulos oficiales y servicios de naturaleza academica en la Universidad de Oviedo durante el curso 2026-2027 (BOPA num. 121, 25.6.2026, Cod. 2026-05349). Articulo 1.2 verbatim: 'La Universidad de Oviedo PODRA diferenciar el precio del credito cuando se trate de personas extranjeras mayores de dieciocho anos que no tengan la condicion de residentes, excluidas las nacionales de Estados miembros de la Union Europea y aquellas a quienes sea de aplicacion el regimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad. Asimismo, podra diferenciar el precio en el caso de estudiantes visitantes, teniendo tal consideracion quienes lo sean de conformidad con lo establecido en la normativa de la Universidad de Oviedo. En ambos casos, el precio de la matricula PODRA CUBRIR HASTA EL 100% DE LOS COSTES de las ensenanzas universitarias de Grado y de Master Universitario.' Same structural model as Catalonia and Andalusia: the decree authorises, the university sets. What Oviedo actually charges: its own matriculation instructions state that for GRADO, non-resident foreign students over 18 pay the THIRD-enrolment rate for the relevant experimentality level. If Oviedo applies the same logic to master's, the effective rate would be 104.25 EUR/ECTS at level 1 or 88.16 at level 2 - i.e. roughly a x4 multiplier, the worst effective outcome modelled anywhere in this sweep. That extrapolation is NOT confirmed for master's and must not be treated as a figure: the matriculation instruction text located covers Grado only. A human should obtain Oviedo's master matriculation instructions or its Consejo de Gobierno tariff resolution. Note the decree extends the same power to 'estudiantes visitantes', closing that route too.

detail: EXTENDS the wave-3 La Rioja finding (24.61 -> 47.94 EUR/ECTS) by pinning the instrument chain. La Rioja does NOT issue an annual decree: the standing instrument is DECRETO 94/2020, por el que se regulan los precios publicos por servicios academicos de la Universidad de La Rioja, and it is amended when rates change - the most recent amendment located is DECRETO 46/2025, de 23 de diciembre, which the Gobierno de La Rioja approved expressly to hold prices UNCHANGED ('congeladas') for the following course. So the 24.61 / 47.94 pair should carry forward into 2026-27 and, absent a new amendment, into 2027-28. IMPORTANT ADJACENT DEVELOPMENT that does NOT help this candidate: Ley 3/2026, de 1 de julio, de la gratuidad de los estudios oficiales de grado universitario o estudios superiores equivalentes en La Rioja (BOE-A-2026-15463) makes GRADO free - it is confined to grado/equivalent, not master, and free-tuition laws of this kind are gated on regional ties, so it must not be read as a master's benefit. Effective multiplier on the master credit: 47.94 / 24.61 = x1.948, close to Madrid's x1.867. This is the ONE community in the map where the gap is caused by a hard fetch block rather than by an unpublished figure. A human must open the UCLM matricula/precios page in a normal browser, or request the tariff from UCLM admissions. Structurally CLM sits in the same family as Catalonia, Andalusia, Asturias and Navarra - decree authorises, university decides - which in practice has meant a real and sometimes severe surcharge (UPC ~x2.3, Oviedo grado ~x4), so CLM should NOT be assumed surcharge-free.
